mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM referral_commission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 1 AND direction = 1
SELECT rc.title AS userName, rc.description AS avatar, rc.amount AS amount FROM referral_commission rc WHERE rc.user_id = #{userId} AND rc.type = 1 AND rc.direction = 1 ORDER BY rc.create_time DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(rc.amount), 0) FROM referral_commission rc INNER JOIN tb_vip_order vo ON rc.order_id = vo.id WHERE rc.user_id = #{inviterUserId} AND vo.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND rc.type = 1 AND rc.direction = 1
